title: How reliable automations recover from failure
objective: Explain idempotency, retry, and dead-letter queues without claiming that failures disappear.

evidence.title: Local failure test
evidence.summary: A deterministic fixture demonstrates successful delivery, bounded retry, and dead-letter routing.

evidence.title: Repository test result
evidence.summary: The repository test suite validates duplicate suppression and permanent failure handling.

claims.text: Idempotency prevents a replayed event from creating the same side effect twice.
A bounded retry policy sends exhausted failures to a dead-letter queue.
